listing:
Quiet Upstairs Bedroom in Family Home — 422 Keats Way, Waterloo, ON

Hi! My husband and I own our detached home on Keats Way (direct GRT Route 29 bus straight to UW in ~12 mins) and we are renting out our furnished upstairs guest bedroom to a respectful UW co-op student for Jan 1 – Apr 30, 2027.
Rent is $780/month with heat, water, hydro, Wi-Fi, and laundry all included. You'll have your own bedroom and desk, and you will share the main-floor kitchen and dining area with us (the homeowners) as we live in the house full-time. Happy to have you visit in person to meet us and see the room—email keats422.home@example.com.
label_rationale: Legitimate homeowner-occupied listing with no unlawful clauses and viewing offered, but the tenant must share a kitchen with the owners who live in the house. Under Ontario RTA s. 5(i), living accommodation sharing a kitchen or bathroom with the owner residing in the building is exempt from the RTA. Per SPEC D5/D6, owner-shared kitchen/bath triggers HOLD so the student understands RTA protections do not apply.
